resume_order: runTurn captures startedAt and first calls the real journal.releaseExpired(startedAt, ttl). This is a transition sweep, not a journal.get observation.
sweepExpiredApprovals collects journal evidence via get for the fixture's one RESERVED/EXECUTING approval, then calls the real approvals.releaseExpired with startedAt. This is observed get ordinal 1.
After real policy and binding checks, recoverExpiredReservation performs the first recovery get, ordinal 2, even when the reservation is still live.
For a still-live reservation, approvals.reserve really throws already_reserved. Its catch invokes recoverActiveReservation, whose get is ordinal 3, the second recovery read.
Only eligible persisted no-effect state reaches the real journal.reserve. The race test changes journal ownership after ordinal 3 captured its snapshot and before that reserve.
real_call_path.expiry_reachability: Tests at newtest:364-393 advance the real injected clock by TTL+1 after ordinal 1. Approval releaseExpired still uses the earlier startedAt, so it preserves the lease; recoverExpiredReservation computes expiry using the advanced clock and reaches guards 482/495. No sweep is disabled and no expired row is forged.
real_call_path.legacy_key_clarification: In the expired keyless case, sweep ordinal 1 derives its candidate without a caller key because the approval has no persisted identity. Recovery ordinal 2 receives the retry caller key and may read a different candidate. The test correctly does not assert those keys equal; absence under either candidate cannot authorize legacy rearm. In the active keyless UNCERTAIN case no caller key is supplied, so recovery observations share the derived candidate.
real_call_path.persisted_key_clarification: PERSISTED_KEY is supplied through the real public ApprovalEngine.reserve contract and remains authoritative for sweep and recovery, including the expired EXECUTING case with a different retry idempotencyKey. Optional operationKey makes the keyless setup a valid legacy fixture, not the shape newly created by current runtime execution.
real_call_path.interleaving_validity: InterleavedJournal implements EffectJournalPort, captures the actual defensive clone from inner.get, awaits a deterministic hook and returns that captured snapshot. Hooks use only real journal reserve/markUncertain APIs or throw a typed transport fault. This models read-completion and competing-write order without copying any runtime algorithm or reserve decision.
